Container.Name: broccoli_splittarr
Container.Overview: Splittarr splits single-file albums with CUE sheets into FLAC tracks for Lidarr when an import fails, then removes only its generated tracks after Lidarr imports them. Configure the Lidarr URL and API key. **Important:** The Downloads (Base) path must be the base download directory (e.g. `/mnt/user/data/mediatemp/torrents`), and the Downloads Complete path must be the subdirectory containing completed downloads (e.g. `/mnt/user/data/mediatemp/torrents/complete`). Splittarr looks for albums under `/downloads/complete` — both mounts must use the exact same container path Lidarr reports. The built-in web UI has no authentication; keep it on a trusted network and do not expose it publicly.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Container Port: 9899 — Splittarr web UI (no authentication)

Config.Name: Downloads (Base)
Config.Description: Base download directory. Must include the complete/ subdirectory. Map to the same path Lidarr uses for downloads.

Config.Name: Downloads Complete
Config.Description: Completed downloads subdirectory. Splittarr looks here for albums to split. Must be a subdirectory of the Downloads (Base) mount above.

Config.Name: Lidarr URL
Config.Description: Required. Lidarr base URL reachable from this container (for example, http://<unraid-ip>:8686 or http://lidarr:8686 on a shared user-defined network).

Config.Name: Lidarr API Key
Config.Description: Required. Lidarr API key from Settings → General.

Config.Name: Bind Address
Config.Description: Listen on all container interfaces so the mapped web UI port is reachable.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Directory for Splittarr's SQLite database; keep this on the persistent AppData mount.
